contact.basis: Rue Saint-Louis sidewalk outside the northwest courtyard entry wing.

verticalDatum: Canadian Geodetic Vertical Datum 2013 (CGVD2013), NRCan HRDEM Mosaic
attribution: Natural Resources Canada, HRDEM Mosaic, Open Government Licence – Canada
method: Unmodified NRCan ground-elevation GeoTIFF sampled bilinearly at pixel centers after WGS84 to EPSG:3979 projection. No flattening, building fitting or gap interpolation. Local 5 m review grid retains the southwest rise and cliff.
limitations: Ground returns under buildings are interpolated by the source product. Sampling resolution is not a claim of survey accuracy.
Runtime terrain-contact placement uses the stated Rue Saint-Louis sidewalk reference. Other host terrain datasets may differ.
